plugins.name: config-evolve
plugins.description: Runs Claude Code's built-in /insights command for you and turns its report into applied config improvements. On demand or monthly it generates a fresh /insights analysis under the hood, captures the fixes it drafts (CLAUDE.md rules, skills, hooks, headless scripts), extends them with the change types /insights skips (permission allowlist entries, saved slash commands, MCP servers, settings tweaks), diffs against prior months so applied or rejected items never reappear, writes a dated review doc, and applies the ones you approve with backups. Never auto-applies. Complements setup-audit by focusing on what to add

plugins.name: setup-audit
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code installation for bloat, conflicts, and duplicate/overlapping skills and plugins

plugins.name: yt-tutorial
plugins.description: Turn a YouTube video into a complete, beginner-friendly, publication-ready tutorial: fetch the transcript, research examples, and rewrite in a conversational explainer voice

plugins.name: transcript-to-notebooklm
plugins.description: Clean .srt/.vtt subtitles or timestamped transcripts into plain .txt, then create a NotebookLM notebook and upload them as sources via the nlm CLI

plugins.name: prompt-master
plugins.description: Generates a single production-ready prompt for any AI tool (LLM, coding agent, image AI, video AI) from a rough idea. Identifies the target tool, extracts the user's actual intent, and outputs one paste-ready, token-efficient prompt with no framework names or prompting theory. Use when writing, fixing, improving, or adapting a prompt.

plugins.name: future-self
plugins.description: Run the Future-Self Prompt: narrate a day in your life 3 years out, keep what feels real, turn it into a daily routine and 90-day plan, and save each quarterly run to one vault note for comparison.

plugins.name: megarag
plugins.description: Phase-by-phase builder for a multimodal RAG app (docs, images, video, audio, knowledge graph, 5 query modes, cited streaming chat) on Next.js 16, Supabase pgvector, Gemini, Docling, and the Workflow SDK. October 2026 refresh of the MegaRAG Build Prompts guide, with a tested schema.
